title: Split agent, MCP, and tool crate tests by behavior boundary
description: The remaining test facades for agent, MCP, and tool crates are still broad behavior aggregates. This is a low-risk decoupling pass that should split tests before request decoration, MCP runtime/transport, and tool reference/command work expand. The split should keep source behavior unchanged and only move tests plus shared test helpers.

files.change: Moved shared helpers such as NoopSink and test events into a support module.
Grouped preference, session context, quote context, persona, and envelope tests.
Grouped token counting, truncation, compression, and context window decorator tests.
Grouped ChatAgentRunner success, fallback, and error propagation behavior.
Split config, tool argument, resource bridge, prompt/sampling, elicitation, and roots tests into focused modules.
Split catalog, provider schema serializer, command descriptor, conflict detection, source, internal provider, and reference tests.

criteria: No production source behavior changes are made.
Agent tests are grouped by request decoration, context management, runner behavior, and tool-loop policy.
MCP tests are grouped by protocol surface so future transport/runtime tests do not grow one large file.
Tool tests are grouped by catalog, schema, command, and conflict responsibilities.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-agent && cargo test -p astrbot-mcp && cargo test -p astrbot-tool && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
